title: BLOODVOLT
subtitle: GAME ONE ULTIMATE
tagline: Cyberpunk arena combat. 384 endgame paths. One life at a time.
description: Persistent .io-style PvP arena combat. Six chassis, four tiers of class progression with 384 endgame paths, 16 achievements, 14 weekly mutators, 5 biome bosses, kill-cam replay, and friend-build sharing via portable codes. No accounts. No backend. Just the fight.

classShowcase.name: RAZOR
classShowcase.bio: Ex-corp enforcer. Knows too much. Slow saw, body-slam focus.

classShowcase.name: VIPE
classShowcase.bio: Teen anarchist. Pure rate of fire, fragile frame.

classShowcase.name: KHAOS
classShowcase.bio: Debt slave. Doesn't speak. Massive HP, brutal cones.

classShowcase.name: WRAITH
classShowcase.bio: Widow pilot. Hunting names. Cloaked dives, 1.6× crits.

classShowcase.name: MAGNUM
classShowcase.bio: Washed-up merc. Drinks mid-match. Single shells, 4-radius AoE.

classShowcase.name: PULSE
classShowcase.bio: Black-market medic. Chains 3, lifesteals on hit.

changelog.summary: GAME ONE ULTIMATE — sealed launch. Apr-26 balance pass for survivability and felt depth.
highlights: Base HP 120 → 180; regen 14 → 26 HP/s; AI count 6 → 4
Sharpened L10 class mods across all 24 entries — clearer roles
Live HUD stats card: CLASS / DPS / MAX HP / SPEED — class-ups now visibly land
Voicelines suppressed during 3s kill-cam window; weather particles halved
Validation Part F: 5/5 P1, 5/5 P2, 5/9 P3 closed
